'''Brad Narong''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], he tried to fix some malfunctioning warden [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], but all the vital parts were stolen by a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] convicts, who then used the parts to build turret defenses. He tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacer to destroy the Mandalorian turrets and salvage the stolen droid parts from them so he can repair his droids.<ref name="TOR" />
